# f5xc_cloud_credentials (Resource)

Cloud Credentials object is used to give user cloud credentials to public cloud like<br>AWS, Azure and GCP. These credentials can then be used by different features in volterra<br>to perform cloud API(s) on users behalf.

To get more information about f5xc_cloud_credentials, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/cloud-credentials)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Cloud Credentials - Basic

resource "f5xc_cloud_credentials" "example" {
  name      = "example-cloud-cred"
  namespace = "system"

  cloud_choice = {
    aws_secret_key = {
      access_key = "AKIAEXAMPLE123"
      secret_key = {
        secret_info_choice = {
          clear_secret_info = {
            url = "string:///U0VDUkVUMQ=="
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```terraform
# Example: Cloud Credentials - Full

resource "f5xc_cloud_credentials" "example" {
  name        = "example-cloud-cred"
  namespace   = "system"
  description = "cloud credentials full"

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "platform"
  }

  cloud_choice = {
    aws_assume_role = {
      role_arn         = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/f5xc-role"
      session_name     = "cloud-f5xc-deployment"
      duration_seconds = 3600
      session_tags = {
        env  = "example"
        team = "infra"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
